# Lifeline

> Automatic margin top-up for Hyperliquid traders, from a vault on NEAR that only ever pays the user's own Hyperliquid address. Agents can read accounts, run storm tests and prepare unsigned transactions through an MCP server; only a person can sign.

- MCP server (streamable HTTP, no sign-in): https://lifeline-mcp.prashantthakur.dev/mcp
- The mainnet vault is live and has paid one real rescue. Its keeper doesn't run around the clock yet, so mainnet sign-up is closed; use testnet.
- The demo keeper at lifeline-sim.prashantthakur.dev is a simulation with real prices and quotes.

- [Security](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Prashant-thakur77/LifeLine/main/SECURITY.md): guarantees and what they rest on
